svg.title: Write the recipes: before and after the recipe check
svg.desc: Before: Pour the milk over the breadcrumbs and let it soak for 10 minutes. recipe_guard.sh reports Error: the step uses 'milk' without an amount. After: Pour 1.5 dl milk over 1 dl breadcrumbs and let it soak for 10 min. 0 errors. Caption: Strict rules guide the AI model, so the recipes are easy to read.
svg.text: the step uses 'milk' without an amount
